name: Auto-J
description: Auto-J is a generative judge model designed to evaluate alignment of large language models across diverse real-world scenarios. It supports multiple evaluation protocols including pairwise response comparison and single-response evaluation, providing interpretable natural language critiques.
reputation: A recent academic proposal for LLM-as-a-judge evaluation that has attracted interest in alignment and evaluation research, but it is not yet a broadly established community benchmark.
notes: Covers 58 different scenarios and supports diverse evaluation protocols with natural language critiques.
